jobs.name: daily-pr-review

jobs.name: b2b-reply-scanner-4h
jobs.description: Scan Gmail for B2B prospect replies every 4 hours

payload.message:
Scan Gmail (a@muso.ai) for new B2B Ads outreach replies in the last 245 minutes (4h plus 5min overlap). Use gog to check recent inbox. Filter for replies from B2B prospects we have emailed (cross-reference with the B2B outreach sheet). IGNORE all internal emails (from muso.ai domains), SaaS notifications, marketing emails, and anything that is not a direct reply from a B2B prospect.

Always emit a visible final assistant message. Never end the run with a thinking-only response. The visible message MUST be one of these two forms and nothing else:

(A) If there are no new B2B prospect replies, your final visible message is exactly: NO_REPLY (uppercase, nothing else — no preamble, no explanation, no markdown, no punctuation, no quotes). OpenClaw recognises this token and will silently complete the run without posting to Slack.

(B) If you find an actual B2B prospect reply, format the visible message as: sender name, company, reply summary, and suggested next action. Also sync GHL pipeline stage if applicable (move to Replied or Meeting Booked).

Run the AMP Daily Report. Query core-backend tables public_ad_events and public_ads via Athena (workgroup: clio-agent, region: us-west-2). Build report: 1) Summary: all-time/7d/today views, clicks, CTR, unique viewers with deltas. 2) Top 5 ads by CTR. 3) Underperformers (CTR < 0.3% with >1K views). 4) AMP vs Feed breakdown. 5) Platform breakdown. 6) Daily trend 7 days. Format for Slack bullets, keep short.

jobs.name: daily-dev-activity-report

For each developer (adk47=Aaron, liflovs=Serhii), run the dev-report.sh script or use gh CLI to get commits from the last 24h across all Muso-AI repos (core-backend, web-credits, platform-data-processing, industry-data-processing, analytics-worker, mobile, devops, feed-service, customer-api-mcp, render-service, web-encore). jobs.name: credit-verification-batch-4h
jobs.description: Autonomous drain of the unverified-credits queue via the Lobster pipeline. Fires every 4h, triggers a real-apply 500-credit FIFO batch through the @Ops dispatcher (matches the regex in muso-ops-credit-verification/SKILL.md).
